finding: Vitest browser mode is correctly configured with Playwright Chromium, headless, 1280x720 viewport, and 30s test timeout — exactly matching enterprise Shadow DOM requirements.
Coverage provider is v8 with appropriate exclusions for styles, stories, and index re-exports, but coverage is disabled by default in CI — only enabled via pnpm run test:coverage.
recommendation: Consider enabling a lightweight coverage pass in CI on changed components only; the current smart-test script already scopes to changed components and the overhead would be minimal.

finding: coverage-config.json lists 95% threshold as the target but shows 76 out of ~80 components as explicitly exempted, meaning the coverage gate is effectively unenforced for nearly the entire library.
recommendation: Establish a rolling remediation schedule: remove no more than 5 exemptions per sprint rather than bulk-exempting the entire library; bind each exemption removal to a completed qa-engineer-automation feature ticket.

finding: Global afterEach(cleanup) pattern is consistent across all test files examined; fixtureContainer.innerHTML = '' correctly resets DOM state between tests without leaving orphaned custom elements.
test-utils.ts correctly exports fixture, shadowQuery, shadowQueryAll, oneEvent, cleanup, and checkA11y (axe-core WCAG 2.1 AA) — the full canonical utility set for Shadow DOM testing.
recommendation: The fixture() function does not recursively wait for nested updateComplete on child custom elements; add a helper like waitForAll() that accepts a host and resolves all slotted child updateCompletes for composite tests.

finding: Zero Storybook story files in packages/hx-library/src/components/ contain a play() function — the storybook vitest addon is configured but no stories exercise real user interactions via userEvent.
recommendation: Mandate that every interactive component (buttons, inputs, menus, dialogs, etc.) has at least one story with a play() function using userEvent from @storybook/test; assign to qa-engineer-automation as a batch feature.

finding: The vitest.config.ts include pattern covers src/components/**/*.test.ts but the hx-style-scope test lives in src/components/hx-style-scope/__tests__/ — this is an inconsistent convention that could cause future tests to be silently excluded if placed in a __tests__ subdirectory that doesn't match the pattern.
recommendation: Normalize: either always place component tests at hx-foo/hx-foo.test.ts or document the __tests__ pattern as the official convention; update the include glob to explicitly cover both.

finding: hx-menu.test.ts provides comprehensive coverage of hx-menu, hx-menu-item, and hx-menu-divider in a single file with 842 lines covering rendering, events, keyboard navigation, roving tabindex, public methods, typeahead, submenu ARIA, and axe-core audits.
All three custom elements in the hx-menu directory (hx-menu, hx-menu-item, hx-menu-divider) are tested in the consolidated test file with dedicated describe blocks.
Six axe-core test scenarios cover hx-menu with labels, disabled items, checkbox/radio menu items, and hx-menu-divider — all using checkA11y() with full WCAG 2.1 AA ruleset.
Disabled item suppression, loading state event blocking, radio mutual-exclusion, multi-character typeahead buffer, and roving tabindex updates are all exercised.
recommendation: Add a test for hx-menu rendered with zero items (empty menu) to verify focusFirst/focusLast do not throw.

finding: hx-data-table.test.ts is one of the most complete test files in the library — 1143 lines covering rendering, sorting, row selection, row click, empty state, loading state, pagination, keyboard navigation, JSON coercion, CSS parts, i18n, and dynamic data updates.

Edge cases include invalid JSON attribute recovery, sparse rows array, ArrowLeft at first cell boundary, ArrowRight at last cell boundary, single-column table keyboard nav, and cell cache invalidation on rows change.
recommendation: Add coverage for column resize interactions mentioned in coverage-config.json exemption as a known gap.

finding: axe-core audits cover default state, selectable, loading, and empty state; aria-sort ascending/descending/none, aria-selected, aria-busy, role=grid, and tabindex for grid keyboard navigation are all explicitly asserted.

hx-carousel.test.ts covers rendering, ARIA, navigation, loop, autoplay (including prefers-reduced-motion, pause-on-mouseenter, disconnectedCallback cleanup), keyboard, touch swipe (vertical and horizontal), focus management, and axe-core.
hx-carousel-item is tested only compositionally within hx-carousel tests; there is no isolated describe block for hx-carousel-item properties or ARIA contributions.
recommendation: Add a dedicated describe('hx-carousel-item') block testing its role, aria-roledescription, and visibility state changes in isolation.

finding: coverage-config.json notes touch/swipe gesture handling and autoplay interval logic need more coverage; touch swipe tests exist but pointer-based drag (PointerEvent) is not tested, and autoplay resume-on-mouseleave is missing.
recommendation: Add PointerEvent-based swipe simulation and a test that autoplay resumes when mouse leaves the carousel after a mouseenter pause.

finding: hx-nav.test.ts contains 887 lines covering rendering, JSON items converter, label, orientation, links/active state, URL sanitization (javascript: and data: protocol blocking), submenus, mobile toggle, events, keyboard navigation, focusout/outside-click collapse, and i18n overrides.
Three axe-core tests cover horizontal, vertical, and submenu-open states; aria-current, aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-label, and aria-labelledby are all explicitly verified.
recommendation: Add a test that nav-item link has no aria-haspopup when it is a leaf link (current implementation verifies the negative on submenu triggers but not leaf links explicitly).

finding: Keyboard navigation tests use vi.spyOn to verify focus() is called on the correct element rather than checking document.activeElement through shadow boundaries, which is a pragmatic pattern for Lit's delegatesFocus complexity.
recommendation: Where feasible, prefer checking el.shadowRoot.activeElement over focus spies for stronger assertions about which element actually received focus.

finding: coverage-config.json reports hx-button at 64% lines and 50% branches; the test file exists with variant/size/type rendering tests but form-associated integration (formAssociated=true), loading state interaction blocking, and href-link rendering paths are insufficiently covered.
recommendation: Add tests for: button type=submit triggering form submission, loading=true blocking hx-click, href rendering as anchor-like element, and formAction/formMethod attribute reflection.

finding: The button test file lacks axe-core checkA11y() calls; aria-disabled, aria-busy (loading), and aria-label for icon-only buttons are not verified by automated accessibility assertions.
recommendation: Add axe-core tests for disabled state, loading state, and a variant with icon-only content (requiring aria-label).

finding: coverage-config.json classifies hx-accordion as skeleton-only; the test file has 70 tests but coverage is reported below threshold — hx-accordion-item sub-component has a separate describe block but complex animation and focusout-close paths are not covered.
recommendation: Expand to test animation state transitions (is-animating attribute), focusout-triggered collapse, allowMultiple=false enforcement when multiple items are initially expanded, and hx-accordion-item in isolation.

finding: coverage-config.json marks hx-tabs as skeleton-only despite having 76 tests; hx-tab-panel and hx-tab sub-element isolation testing, ARIA tabpanel relationships, and keyboard navigation edge cases (wrapping, disabled tab skipping) need expansion.
recommendation: Add tests for: tab panel hidden attribute toggling, aria-controls/aria-labelledby linkage between tab and panel, disabled tab keyboard skip, and tab panel slot content rendering.

finding: coverage-config.json notes SSR browser API guards bring coverage below threshold; dialog focus trap behavior, Escape key dismiss, and backdrop click dismiss are the most critical untested paths for a modal component.
recommendation: Prioritize focus trap testing (Tab key cycles within dialog, focus returns to trigger on close), Escape key dismiss, backdrop click dismiss, and scroll lock/restore.

finding: Dialog has no axe-core test in the test file for its open state; aria-modal, aria-labelledby, and focus management after open/close are critical accessibility requirements for a modal component that are unverified.
recommendation: Add axe-core checkA11y() tests for: dialog in open state, dialog with aria-labelledby pointing to title slot, and focus restoration on close.

finding: coverage-config.json marks hx-text-input as skeleton-only despite it being a form-associated component (formAssociated=true); ElementInternals setFormValue, constraint validation (required, pattern, minLength), and form reset/restore callbacks are not covered.
recommendation: Add form integration tests: place hx-text-input inside a <form>, submit it, verify FormData value; test required validation reporting, pattern mismatch, and form.reset() clearing the value.

finding: No axe-core checkA11y() calls exist in hx-text-input.test.ts; aria-invalid on validation failure, aria-describedby pointing to help-text, and aria-required are not verified.
recommendation: Add axe-core tests for: valid state, required + empty (aria-invalid=true), and with help-text (aria-describedby wiring).

finding: coverage-config.json reports hx-select below threshold due to SSR guards; as a form-associated component, setFormValue syncing, constraint validation, and keyboard navigation of the options list are the key uncovered paths.
recommendation: Add tests for: option selection updating FormData, keyboard Arrow navigation through options, Enter to confirm selection, Escape to close without selection, and aria-activedescendant updates.

finding: coverage-config.json marks hx-checkbox as skeleton-only; as a form-associated component with indeterminate state, neither the indeterminate visual state, ElementInternals form participation, nor keyboard Enter/Space activation are verified.
recommendation: Add tests for: indeterminate state rendering, Space key toggling checked state, setFormValue with checked/unchecked values, and constraint validation with required attribute.

finding: No aria-checked, aria-required, or aria-invalid assertions exist for hx-checkbox; no axe-core tests are present.
recommendation: Add axe-core tests for: unchecked, checked, indeterminate, required, and disabled states; explicitly assert aria-checked on the shadow DOM input or role=checkbox element.

finding: hx-radio-group has a separate hx-radio.test.ts file for the sub-element but coverage-config.json marks radio-group as skeleton-only; hx-radio sub-element form participation, arrow key selection, and roving tabindex are the key gaps.
recommendation: Expand hx-radio.test.ts to cover: Arrow key focus movement between radios, Enter/Space selection, aria-checked state toggling, formAssociated value reporting, and required validation.

finding: hx-radio has its own test file (hx-radio.test.ts) which is a good pattern, but coverage-config.json indicates the group's validation state propagation and error describedby wiring are not tested.
recommendation: Add integration tests in hx-radio-group.test.ts that verify the group's error message is linked to all child radios via aria-describedby.

finding: coverage-config.json marks hx-switch as skeleton-only; as a form-associated component, setFormValue, checked/unchecked value submission, and Space key activation are not verified.
recommendation: Add tests: Space key toggles checked, form submission includes switch value when checked, submission excludes value when unchecked, and aria-checked reflects state.

finding: coverage-config.json notes SSR browser API guards; textarea as a form-associated component needs form integration tests for setFormValue, minLength/maxLength constraint validation, and auto-resize behavior testing.
recommendation: Add tests for: auto-resize (rows increasing as content grows), maxLength enforcement, setFormValue syncing to FormData, and required validation on empty value.

finding: coverage-config.json flagged hx-number-input as 0% lines; as a form-associated component it requires stepper increment/decrement button tests, min/max clamping, and keyboard Arrow key value changes.
recommendation: Add tests: increment/decrement buttons change value, ArrowUp/ArrowDown keyboard increment, min/max boundaries clamp value, step attribute controls increment size, and setFormValue syncs to FormData.

finding: coverage-config.json notes SSR guards; slider is form-associated and requires ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End keyboard value change tests, min/max/step attribute enforcement, and setFormValue integration.
recommendation: Add tests: Arrow keys adjust value by step, Home/End jump to min/max, pointer drag simulation (PointerEvent), and form submission includes slider value.

finding: coverage-config.json marks hx-combobox as skeleton-only; as a form-associated composite widget with ARIA combobox pattern (role=combobox, aria-expanded, aria-activedescendant, aria-controls), the coverage gap is critical for healthcare accessibility compliance.
recommendation: Treat hx-combobox as P0 for test expansion: cover open/close state, option keyboard navigation, Enter to select, Escape to close, filtered results, aria-activedescendant updates, and form value submission.

finding: coverage-config.json notes calendar grid keyboard navigation and locale-specific edge cases are unaddressed; hx-date-picker is form-associated and must work correctly in healthcare date-of-birth and appointment scheduling contexts.
recommendation: Add tests: calendar grid Arrow key navigation, Page Up/Down month navigation, Home/End in week row, invalid date input handling, locale formatting verification, and setFormValue with ISO date string.

finding: No axe-core tests exist for hx-date-picker open/closed states; the calendar grid requires specific ARIA grid roles, aria-label on day cells, and aria-selected for chosen date — none of which are currently verified.
recommendation: Add axe-core tests for: picker closed state, picker open state with calendar grid, selected date state, and disabled dates.

finding: coverage-config.json notes time parsing edge cases and AM/PM toggle interactions need coverage; as a form-associated component used in healthcare scheduling, 12-hour/24-hour parsing and invalid time input recovery are critical paths.
recommendation: Add tests: AM/PM toggle changes hour value, 24-hour format parsing, invalid time string falls back gracefully, Arrow key hour/minute increment, and setFormValue with time string.

finding: coverage-config.json notes drag-and-drop and file validation paths require browser File API infrastructure not yet in place; hx-file-upload is form-associated and critical for healthcare document workflows.
recommendation: Use vitest browser mode DataTransfer API mock to simulate file drop; test accept attribute filtering, maxSize validation rejection, multiple=false single-file enforcement, and hx-file-change event payload.

finding: coverage-config.json notes recursive tree rendering and deep keyboard traversal are coverage gaps; hx-tree-view has 83 tests but nested node expand/collapse state management and ArrowRight to expand / ArrowLeft to collapse patterns need verification.
recommendation: Add tests: ArrowRight on collapsed node expands it, ArrowLeft on leaf node moves to parent, Home/End navigate to first/last visible node, and aria-expanded reflects expand state on tree items.

finding: coverage-config.json marks hx-tooltip as skeleton-only with 34 tests; hover-show/focus-show/keyboard-show lifecycle, positioning logic, and Escape key dismiss are the core untested behaviors.
recommendation: Add tests: tooltip shows on trigger focus, tooltip shows on trigger mouseenter, tooltip hides on Escape, tooltip hides on focusout, and aria-describedby on trigger references tooltip id.

finding: No axe-core tests exist for hx-tooltip; the aria-describedby relationship between trigger and tooltip content is one of the most commonly violated ARIA patterns in component libraries.
recommendation: Add axe-core tests for tooltip in both hidden and visible states; explicitly assert that the trigger element has aria-describedby pointing to the tooltip's id.

finding: coverage-config.json notes branch coverage at 76% (below 80%); open/close animation states and positioning edge cases (viewport overflow) are the likely uncovered branches.
recommendation: Add tests for: trigger click opens dropdown, outside click closes dropdown, Escape closes dropdown, keyboard focus within open dropdown, and trigger aria-expanded reflects open state.

finding: coverage-config.json flagged hx-overflow-menu as 0% lines; this is a frequently-used composite UI element in data-dense healthcare interfaces and has no meaningful test coverage at all.
recommendation: Create comprehensive tests covering: trigger button opens/closes the overflow panel, keyboard navigation within overflow items, outside click closes panel, Escape key closes panel, and item selection dispatches correct event.

finding: coverage-config.json notes SSR guards; pagination requires tests for prev/next button disabled states at boundaries, page count calculation, hx-page-change event payload, and aria-label on page buttons.
recommendation: Add tests: prev button disabled on first page, next button disabled on last page, page button aria-current on active page, hx-page-change event detail includes page number, and ellipsis rendering at large page counts.

finding: coverage-config.json marks hx-popover as skeleton-only; popover differs from tooltip in that it can contain interactive content, requiring focus trap testing and aria-modal or aria-label on the popover container.
recommendation: Add tests: popover opens on trigger, focus trap within open popover, Tab does not escape to page behind, Escape closes popover, and popover has accessible name via aria-label or aria-labelledby.

finding: coverage-config.json marks hx-drawer as skeleton-only with 67 tests; open/close animation lifecycle, focus management on open (first focusable element receives focus), focus trap, and backdrop click are the critical uncovered paths.
recommendation: Add tests: focus moves to first focusable element on open, Tab key cycles within open drawer, backdrop click closes drawer, Escape closes drawer, and aria-modal is set when open.

finding: coverage-config.json notes branch coverage at 73%; split button requires tests for the secondary trigger (chevron) opening the menu independently from the primary action button, and keyboard separation between the two.
recommendation: Add tests: primary button click fires hx-click, secondary trigger click opens attached menu, Enter on secondary trigger opens menu (not primary action), and aria-expanded on secondary trigger reflects menu state.

finding: coverage-config.json notes drag-to-resize pointer event coverage requires additional gesture simulation; hx-split-panel handles PointerEvent drag and keyboard resize (Arrow keys on divider handle).
recommendation: Add tests: PointerEvent drag simulation changes panel sizes, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight keyboard resize on divider, Home/End jumps to min/max split, and aria-valuenow/aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax on the divider handle.

finding: coverage-config.json notes canvas/pointer event interactions are difficult to cover; however, hex input field update, swatch selection, and form value submission are not canvas-dependent and represent achievable coverage targets.
recommendation: Add non-canvas tests: hex input changes color value, hx-color-change event fires with correct hex payload, swatches (if present) set value on click, and form submission includes color value.

finding: hx-patient-banner is a healthcare-specific component with no meaningful test coverage (coverage-config.json: 'tests to be added in dedicated feature'); displaying PHI correctly and handling missing/redacted data states are critical for patient safety.
recommendation: This is the highest-priority healthcare component for test creation: verify patient name slot rendering, DOB formatting, MRN display, allergy alert visibility, PHI redaction mode (if applicable), and axe-core compliance.

finding: No axe-core tests exist for hx-patient-banner; in healthcare environments, patient identification UI must be screen-reader accessible and WCAG 2.1 AA compliant — this is a zero-tolerance gap.
recommendation: Add axe-core checkA11y() as the first test written for this component; it must pass before any other test is considered complete.

finding: hx-phi-field (Protected Health Information field) is marked skeleton-only in coverage-config.json; this component handles sensitive PHI display/masking and requires tests for reveal/mask toggle behavior, aria-label changes on toggle, and screen-reader announcement of state changes.
recommendation: Add tests: PHI is masked by default, toggle button reveals PHI, aria-label on toggle reflects current state ('Show PHI'/'Hide PHI'), live region announces state change to screen readers, and masked state does not expose PHI to accessibility tree.

finding: No accessibility tests exist for hx-phi-field; a healthcare PHI masking component with no ARIA verification is a patient privacy and regulatory compliance risk.
recommendation: Add axe-core tests for both masked and revealed states; verify aria-live region announces PHI visibility changes; confirm PHI text is not exposed in aria-label or aria-describedby when masked.

finding: coverage-config.json reports 0% lines and 33% branches/functions for hx-toast; toast requires tests for auto-dismiss timer, manual dismiss button, aria-live region announcement, and multiple toast stacking behavior.
recommendation: Add tests: toast appears and dispatches hx-show, auto-dismiss fires hx-hide after duration, close button fires hx-hide, aria-live='polite' or aria-live='assertive' is set based on variant, and toast is removed from DOM after hide animation.

finding: No axe-core tests exist for hx-toast; aria-live region configuration is the primary a11y mechanism for toasts and must be verified as it directly impacts whether screen reader users receive notifications.
recommendation: Add axe-core tests for each toast variant (info, success, warning, error) and explicitly assert role='status' or role='alert' is set correctly with corresponding aria-live value.

finding: coverage-config.json reports 0% lines for hx-code-snippet; the copy-to-clipboard functionality and syntax highlighting integration are completely untested.
recommendation: Add tests: code content renders in shadow DOM, copy button triggers clipboard write, hx-copy event dispatches after clipboard write, and aria-label on copy button reflects copy/copied state.

finding: coverage-config.json reports 0% lines for hx-copy-button; clipboard interactions in browser mode can be tested using Playwright's browser context API but no tests exist.
recommendation: Add tests: click triggers navigator.clipboard.writeText with correct content, button label changes to 'Copied' after success, resets after timeout, hx-copy event fires, and error state handles clipboard permission denial.

finding: hx-form is marked skeleton-only in coverage-config.json; as a form wrapper component it should validate that form-associated child components participate in its submission lifecycle and that native form reset propagates to all hx-* form controls.
recommendation: Add integration tests: hx-form submission collects values from hx-text-input/hx-select/hx-checkbox children, reset clears all form-associated children, invalid children prevent submission, and hx-submit event fires with FormData payload.

finding: coverage-config.json notes SSR guards below threshold for hx-side-nav; as a navigation component used for primary app navigation it requires tests for collapse/expand behavior, active item tracking, nested item keyboard navigation, and aria-current on current route.
recommendation: Add tests: collapse/expand toggle, aria-current on active item, keyboard Arrow navigation, aria-expanded on items with children, and mobile breakpoint behavior.

finding: hx-top-nav has only 27 tests (coverage-config.json: skeleton-only); user menu, mobile hamburger toggle, search slot, and action slot interactions are not covered.
recommendation: Add tests: user menu opens/closes, hamburger menu toggles mobile layout, search slot content renders, action slot content renders, and keyboard navigation between top-level items.

finding: coverage-config.json reports 0% lines/statements for hx-rating; as a form-associated interactive widget, star selection, keyboard Arrow navigation, hover preview, and form value submission are all untested.
recommendation: Add tests: click on star sets value, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight changes value, hover previews value change, aria-checked or aria-valuenow reflects current rating, and form submission includes rating value.

finding: hx-icon-button is form-associated (formAssociated=true) and marked skeleton-only in coverage-config.json with 48 tests; icon-only button requires aria-label to be mandatory and tested, and loading state event suppression needs verification.
recommendation: Add tests: missing aria-label triggers console warning (or fails axe audit), loading=true blocks hx-click, Enter/Space dispatches hx-click, and form type=submit triggers form submission.

finding: hx-toggle-button is form-associated and marked skeleton-only with 61 tests; pressed state ARIA (aria-pressed), Space key toggle, and form value participation need verification.
recommendation: Add tests: aria-pressed reflects pressed state, Space key toggles pressed state, form submission includes pressed value, and hx-toggle event fires with pressed detail.

finding: hx-steps has SSR guards below threshold; step component requires tests for completed/active/pending state rendering, aria-label for each step indicating current status, and step click navigation event.
recommendation: Add tests: completed step renders completed indicator, active step has aria-current='step', pending step is visually distinct, click dispatches hx-step-change, and overall progress is conveyed to screen readers.

finding: hx-progress-bar is marked skeleton-only; the aria-valuenow/aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax pattern is the primary accessibility mechanism and is not verified; indeterminate state (no value) also lacks tests.
recommendation: Add tests: aria-valuenow reflects value property, aria-valuemin defaults to 0, aria-valuemax defaults to 100, indeterminate=true removes aria-valuenow, and value 0/100 boundary conditions render correctly.

finding: hx-progress-ring mirrors progress-bar accessibility requirements (aria-valuenow, indeterminate) and is marked skeleton-only; SVG-based progress indicators require verified aria attributes as visual position is meaningless to AT.
recommendation: Add tests matching hx-progress-bar recommendations plus verification that SVG elements use aria-hidden=true (decorative) while the host carries the ARIA role and value attributes.

finding: hx-meter has 55 tests but coverage-config.json marks it skeleton-only; native <meter> element ARIA mapping is complex and the optimum/low/high threshold rendering needs explicit verification.
recommendation: Add tests: optimum range renders with positive visual indicator, low/high threshold visual changes, aria-valuenow/min/max on the host, and axe-core audit.

finding: hx-alert has SSR guards causing coverage gap; the alert/alertdialog role distinction based on variant, aria-live region, and dismiss button (when closeable) are the key uncovered paths.
recommendation: Add tests: error/warning variant uses role=alert, info variant uses role=status, dismissible=true renders close button, close button dispatches hx-close event, and axe-core passes.

finding: hx-banner is marked below threshold due to SSR guards; similar to hx-alert, the role, live region politeness, and dismiss behavior need test coverage.
recommendation: Add tests matching hx-alert recommendations; verify that banner-level alerts use role=alert while informational banners use role=status with aria-live=polite.

finding: Of 18 form-associated components identified (hx-button, hx-checkbox, hx-checkbox-group, hx-color-picker, hx-combobox, hx-date-picker, hx-file-upload, hx-icon-button, hx-number-input, hx-radio-group, hx-rating, hx-select, hx-slider, hx-switch, hx-text-input, hx-textarea, hx-time-picker, hx-toggle-button), none have a comprehensive form integration test that exercises the full ElementInternals lifecycle: setFormValue, formResetCallback, and formStateRestoreCallback.
recommendation: Create a shared form-integration test helper that constructs a real <form> element, appends each form-associated component, submits it, verifies FormData output, resets it, and verifies value clearing; run this helper from each component's test file.

finding: Several test files access private implementation details directly (e.g., el['_currentIndex'], el['_autoplayTimer']) for assertion; while pragmatic for Lit reactive property testing, this creates brittle tests that break on refactoring.
recommendation: Prefer testing observable outcomes (aria attributes, DOM state, dispatched events) over private properties; when private state must be checked, document why in the test comment so the coupling intent is explicit.

finding: The single shared fixtureContainer at module scope in test-utils.ts is reused across all tests; if a test throws before cleanup() runs (e.g., in a promise chain without proper async/await), the container may retain elements and pollute subsequent tests.
recommendation: Wrap the fixture container creation in a beforeAll hook that creates it fresh, and consider using a WeakRef-based approach or adding a globalThis beforeEach that calls cleanup() as a safety net even when individual tests forget.

finding: hx-format-date is marked skeleton-only; date formatting components must be tested with locale variations, invalid date inputs, and edge cases like epoch 0 and far-future dates to ensure no NaN or Invalid Date renders in clinical contexts.
recommendation: Add tests: valid ISO date renders in default locale, invalid date input renders fallback text, locale prop changes output format, and epoch/far-future dates do not crash the formatter.

finding: hx-structured-list is marked skeleton-only; as a data display component commonly used for patient information summaries, label/value pair rendering, truncation behavior, and copy-to-clipboard (if supported) need coverage.
recommendation: Add tests: label/value pairs render correctly, long values truncate with ellipsis, aria-label on the list describes its purpose, and axe-core passes on a realistic patient data example.
